description: Lattice brings library track and album collage walls to ECHO. Browse and search tracks or albums, expand album track lists, play a song or an album, and enjoy synchronized lyrics in immersive panels. Licensed under AGPL-3.0-only. Source: https://github.com/bailuoqi/lattice-wall
changeNote: 1.2.0: Smoother collage wall rendering and pointer input; improved cover loading and artwork spacing; library pages now contain 200 tracks; album wall layout and lyrics fixes.
